description: Prone: you have Disadvantage on attack rolls. An attack roll against you has Advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet of you, and Disadvantage otherwise. At the start of your turn you stand up, which costs movement equal to half your Speed; with a Speed of 0 you stay down.
_comment: SRD 5.2.1, Conditions > Prone. Standing up happens automatically at the start of the creature's turn (nat20-table Milestone 5 spec D8); crawling isn't modelled. The attacked-side Advantage or Disadvantage uses its own source (effect.condition.prone.target), so a Prone attacker's own Disadvantage and its Prone target's Advantage both count and cancel.
